comments_text: Sequence analysis: APD analysis reveals that this sequence is most similar (93.55%) to Cecropin P1. K: 17%; V=A=S: 14%. GRAVY: -0.38; M Wt: 3085.582; M formula: C136H236N39O41, mol ex coeff: 5550. Activity: active against E. coli BL21 (MBC 0.05 uM), E. coli ML35 (MBC 0.2 uM), and L. innocua (MBC 2.4 uM). Structure: NMR studies revealed a helical structure (rigid, N15 NOE). You can rotate, zoom, and view the 3D structure here in the PDB. SAR: activity is similar to the intact parent peptide. Also refer to AP134 via the similarity link above.
title: Three-Dimensional Structure of the Antimicrobial Peptide Cecropin P1 in Dodecylphosphocholine Micelles and the Role of the C-Terminal Residues.
